title: Relationship, Genealogy, Organization & Diplomacy Explorer
objective: Deliver family/dynasty, organization hierarchy, allegiance, faction diplomacy and social-graph exploration over MIB-09 and canonical Character/organization relationship owners without creating a second relationship ledger.

bounded_contract.canonical_relationship_contract: MIB-09 and canonical Character, organization and relationship identities remain authoritative. WCI-03 may project stable relationship references but cannot mint a second genealogy, organization, diplomacy or social-graph ledger or rewrite canonical relationship truth.
bounded_contract.genealogy_contract: Family, parent/child, lineage, dynasty and household views preserve stable Character and relationship reference identity, provenance and directionality. Presentation ancestry does not create or delete canonical kinship.
bounded_contract.organization_contract: Organization membership, role, hierarchy and allegiance views consume canonical organization/relationship references. Visual nesting, rank presentation or grouping does not grant membership, office or authority.
bounded_contract.diplomacy_contract: Faction diplomacy and inter-organization stance views project authorized relationship state and provenance. WCI-03 cannot infer treaties, hostility, alliance or canonical political truth from visual proximity, graph topology or labels alone.
bounded_contract.knowledge_boundary: KFR remains the future owner of explicit knowledge/familiarity semantics. WCI-03 cannot infer who knows whom, familiarity, awareness, rumor knowledge or information access from relationship adjacency or shared organization membership.
bounded_contract.visibility_contract: Authorization and visibility filtering precede counts, graph degree, genealogy summaries, organization hierarchy, diplomacy views, reader/GM projections and AI context; hidden/GM/private relationships and protected cardinality cannot leak through aggregate output.
bounded_contract.accessibility_contract: Consequential genealogy, organization, diplomacy and social-graph information requires accessible nonvisual summaries/equivalents; the visual graph is not exclusive truth.
bounded_contract.determinism_contract: Equivalent authorized inputs produce stable node/edge ordering, hierarchy/diplomacy projections and deterministic receipts independent of view/platform; wall-clock timing and canvas position are not semantic truth.
bounded_contract.persistence_decision: No durable WCI-03 persistence is required for this tranche; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
bounded_contract.successor_boundary: WCI-04+, KFR-01+, public/community publishing, paid provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.

acceptance_contract: Test-first RED proves the bounded WCI-03 relationship/genealogy/organization/diplomacy contract and panel do not exist before production implementation.
One relationship explorer projects authorized stable Character, organization and relationship references without creating a parallel relationship ledger.
Genealogy and organization hierarchy preserve relationship directionality, provenance and canonical owner identity.
Diplomacy projections report authorized relationship state without inferring or mutating canonical treaties, alliances, hostility or political truth.
KFR knowledge/familiarity semantics are not inferred from graph adjacency, organization membership or diplomacy relationships.
Hidden/GM/private relationship state and protected cardinality are filtered before counts, graph summaries, diplomacy views, reader/GM projection and AI context.
Consequential relationship results have accessible nonvisual equivalents and deterministic ordering/receipts independent of input order.
No canonical owner mutation, durable WCI-03 persistence, migration 0022, public publishing, provider activation or WCI-04 ownership is introduced.
Final validation uses exactly one WCI-03 current-family profile, self-hosted Linux, self-hosted Windows and deterministic comparator with zero historical predecessor fanout.
preserved_boundaries: WCI-02 remains completed_verified with retired implementation authority.
MIB-09 and canonical Character/organization/relationship owners remain authoritative.
World/Reality and Permission/visibility owners remain authoritative where relationship projections reference them.
KFR retains future explicit knowledge/familiarity ownership.
Hidden/GM/private relationship content is filtered before aggregate or AI-context projection.
No second relationship/genealogy/organization/diplomacy ledger or automatic canonical mutation is authorized.
No durable WCI-03 ledger or migration 0022 is introduced.
WCI-04+, KFR-01+, public/community publishing, paid provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
